site.sitedescription: Bedrock basin (8m max) in glaciated area. Physiography: Glaciated terrain with low drumlins. Surrounding vegetation: Spruce-fir Coast Zone. Dominant species are Picea mariana and Abies balsamea, along with less abundant Picea glauca.
